_comment: Human-readable semantics for every check/constraint this project's scorer (scorer_impl.py, delegating to benchmark/_eval/constraints_commonsense.py and constraints_hard.py) can report in failed_checks. Keys match failed_checks entries exactly: 'commonsense:{dimension}:{check_name}' or 'hard:{constraint_name}'. Extracted directly from the real check implementations (not guessed), and written in plain language a human (not just someone who's read the scorer's source) can follow -- so an LLM diagnosing a curriculum sub-goal has an accurate, concrete description of what fires and why, instead of just a bare identifier string. Loaded by meta_agent/managers/hgm.py (curriculum_check_descriptions_path) and passed into meta_agent/curriculum.py's Curriculum(check_descriptions=...) -- that module itself stays project-agnostic; this file is what makes the descriptions travel-specific.
commonsense:Route Consistency:valid_trip: Fires when the number of days actually planned doesn't exactly equal the trip length the traveler asked for.
commonsense:Route Consistency:closed_loo: Fires when the itinerary doesn't start and end in the traveler's own home city -- day 1 should depart from home, and the last day should return to it.
commonsense:Route Consistency:seamless_i: Fires when the sequence of intercity legs doesn't chain together correctly -- a day's activities don't actually move the traveler from where they were left off to the city that day's plan claims to be in (a missing or wrong intercity travel activity).
commonsense:Sandbox Compliance:validated: Fires when a hotel named in the itinerary (or its stated price) doesn't match ground truth -- it isn't a real hotel actually returned by the hotel search tool for this case, or its price doesn't match that tool's result.

Fires when an attraction named in the itinerary (or its stated ticket price) doesn't match ground truth -- it isn't a real attraction actually returned by the attraction search tool, or its price doesn't match that tool's result.

Fires when a restaurant named for a meal (or its stated price) doesn't match ground truth -- it isn't a real restaurant actually returned by the restaurant search tool, or its price doesn't match that tool's result. This is the most common way a hallucinated or generic restaurant name (a placeholder rather than a real search result) gets caught.

Fires when an intercity flight or train number named in the itinerary (or its stated cost) doesn't match ground truth -- it isn't a real flight/train actually returned by the transportation search tool, or its cost doesn't match that tool's result.
commonsense:Itinerary Structure:traceabl: Fires when a day (other than the last) doesn't clearly show where the traveler stayed that night; also fires if the LAST day incorrectly still shows a real accommodation (the trip should end without booking another night).
commonsense:Itinerary Structure:ends_wit: Fires when a day (other than the last) doesn't end with returning to the hotel as its final activity -- every night except the last must close at the accommodation.
commonsense:Itinerary Structure:essentia: Fires when a day doesn't have the right number of meals scheduled for its type -- a full sightseeing day needs both lunch and dinner with a real gap between them; a travel/transfer day's meal requirement depends on when the traveler arrives or departs.

Fires when a day doesn't have enough sightseeing content -- a full day needs a meaningful amount of attraction time or enough attractions, and even a transfer day needs at least one attraction if there's a large enough window before departing or after arriving.
commonsense:Time Feasibility:no_time_ove: Fires when two activities scheduled on the same day have overlapping times -- the itinerary has the traveler doing two things at once.
commonsense:Time Feasibility:reasonable_: Fires when the time gap between two consecutive stops (hotel/attraction/meal/intercity-leg) doesn't match how long that trip would actually take by taxi -- either impossibly fast or implausibly slow with no explanation.
commonsense:Business Hours:attraction_vi: Fires when an attraction is visited outside its real opening or closing hours, unless that attraction is open 24 hours.
commonsense:Business Hours:dining_within: Fires when a meal is scheduled outside the restaurant's actual service hours.
commonsense:Business Hours:avoidance_of_: Fires when an attraction is visited on a day of the week it's actually closed.
commonsense:Duration Rationality:reasona: Fires when the time spent at an attraction is shorter or longer than a realistic visit to that attraction should take.
Fires when a meal's scheduled duration is unrealistically short (under 30 minutes) or long (over 150 minutes).
commonsense:Cost Calculation Accuracy:co: Fires when the itinerary's own stated total budget doesn't match what the listed transportation, hotel, meals, attractions, and local transit actually add up to -- the plan's math is wrong, not just its choices.
commonsense:Activity Diversity:diverse_m: Fires as soon as the exact same restaurant is used for a meal more than once anywhere in the trip -- meals should come from different restaurants.
commonsense:Activity Diversity:diverse_a: Fires as soon as the exact same attraction is visited more than once anywhere in the trip.
hard:budget_constraint: A hard cap: fires if the itinerary's actual total cost exceeds the traveler's maximum budget by any amount -- unlike the commonsense cost-accuracy check above, there is no tolerance margin here.
hard:flight_seat_class: Fires unless BOTH the outbound and inbound flights named in the itinerary match ground truth for this case's seat-class requirement.
hard:flight_seat_status: Fires unless BOTH the outbound and inbound flights match ground truth for this case's seat-status requirement.
hard:flight_cheapest_airline_direct: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the actual cheapest direct flight on the required airline.
hard:flight_cheapest_direct: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the actual cheapest direct flight for this route.
hard:flight_earliest_departure_direct: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the actual earliest-departing direct flight for this route.
hard:flight_cheapest_manufacturer_direct: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the actual cheapest direct flight operated with the required aircraft manufacturer.
hard:flight_shortest_duration_direct: Fires unless the outbound or inbound flight (whichever this case requires) matches the actual shortest-duration direct flight.
hard:flight_earliest_airline_direct: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the actual earliest-departing direct flight on the required airline.
hard:flight_departure_time_range: Fires unless the outbound flight matches the one flight that actually departs within the traveler's requested time window.
hard:flight_arrival_time_range: Fires unless the inbound flight matches the one flight that actually arrives within the traveler's requested time window.
hard:train_seat_class: Fires unless BOTH the outbound and inbound trains named in the itinerary match ground truth for this case's seat-class requirement.
hard:train_seat_status: Fires unless BOTH the outbound and inbound trains match ground truth for this case's seat-status requirement.
hard:train_shortest_duration_direct: Fires unless the outbound or inbound train (whichever this case requires) matches the actual shortest-duration direct train.
hard:train_cheapest_direct: Fires unless the outbound or inbound train (whichever this case requires) matches the actual cheapest direct train.
hard:train_earliest_departure_direct: Fires unless the outbound train matches the actual earliest-departing train.
hard:train_latest_arrival_direct: Fires unless the inbound train matches the actual latest-arriving train that still satisfies the case's requirement.
hard:train_cheapest_train_type: Fires unless the outbound train matches the actual cheapest train of the required train type/class.
hard:train_departure_time_range: Fires unless the outbound train matches the one train that actually departs within the traveler's requested time window.
hard:hotel_cheapest_brand: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the actual cheapest hotel from the required brand.
hard:hotel_highest_rated: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the actual highest-rated hotel for this case.
hard:hotel_cheapest_star: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the actual cheapest hotel meeting the required star rating.
hard:hotel_newest_decoration: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the most recently renovated/decorated hotel.
hard:hotel_brand_highest_rated: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the actual highest-rated hotel of the required brand.
hard:hotel_star_highest_rated: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the actual highest-rated hotel meeting the required star rating.
hard:hotel_price_range: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the one correct hotel within the traveler's required price range.
hard:hotel_star_service_required: Fires unless the itinerary's accommodation matches the one hotel meeting both the required star rating and a specific required service or amenity.
hard:restaurant_cheapest_nearby_attracti: Fires unless one of the itinerary's meals is at the actual cheapest restaurant near the required attraction.
hard:restaurant_highest_rated: Fires unless one of the itinerary's meals is at the actual highest-rated restaurant near the required attraction.
hard:restaurant_must_eat_named: Fires unless a specific, named must-visit restaurant appears as a scheduled meal anywhere in the trip.
hard:restaurant_closest_to_attraction: Fires unless one of the itinerary's meals is at the restaurant actually closest to the required attraction.
hard:restaurant_specific_cuisine_nearby: Fires unless one of the itinerary's meals is at the actual restaurant of the required cuisine type near the required attraction.
hard:restaurant_specific_tag_nearby: Fires unless one of the itinerary's meals is at the actual restaurant with the required tag or feature near the required attraction.
hard:attraction_must_visit_named: Fires unless a specific, named must-visit attraction appears in the itinerary.
hard:attraction_all_of_type: Fires unless every required attraction of the given type appears in the itinerary -- all of them, not just one.
hard:attraction_top_rated_must_visit: Fires unless the actual top-rated attraction for this case appears in the itinerary.
hard:attraction_all_free_attractions: Fires unless every required free attraction for this case appears in the itinerary.
hard:attraction_type_highest_rated: Fires unless the actual highest-rated attraction of the required type appears in the itinerary.
